name: Madrasti Management System (MMS)
subtitle: Private School Management Platform
description: A desktop management system built for private schools. It supports student and teacher management, groups, classes, subjects, enrolment, timetables, attendance, appointments, finances, teacher salaries, and reporting. It includes QR-based student check-in, role-based access control, secure licensing, and offline support.

name: FennecGo
subtitle: FinTech Wallet Prototype
description: A prototype digital-wallet platform designed for cash-heavy markets, with separate customer and merchant/agent mobile applications. Features include wallet balances, QR cash-in and top-up flows, peer-to-peer transfers, transaction history, favourites, and agent/store commission workflows.

name: Scootry
subtitle: Scooter Sharing and Rental Application
description: A scooter-sharing and rental application inspired by Lime and BIXI. Users can discover available scooters on a map, create accounts, make rental reservations, and manage rental-related workflows.
